review.method: Complete source video analyzed by Higgsfield (20 scenes), complete local original-audio ASR (105 segments), full-range sequential visual evidence plus key dense sequences.
limitations: ASR retains raw errors; video-tool scene descriptions are cross-checked, not treated as exact.

No claim of original AE plugin, precise easing curve, exact sound effects, or independent validation of product rankings.
In-memory body dense sequences are documented in body-observations.md; no saved image files are claimed for those.

shots.title: 三张会员卡、统一价格和选择疑问
shots.observed: 三张同尺寸白色会员卡保持横向可比，价格先在上方建立共同条件；高亮/光标轮流把注意力移给候选，随后问号承接选择问题。背景已存在排行榜但降权。
shots.viewer_purpose: 先让观众知道比较条件与候选是谁。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 同列产品展开对应作品
shots.observed: 三张卡先缩小并下移；ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 的实际网页/作品缩略图依次从各自卡片附近向上展开，形成对应三列；约8.2秒盖上亲测章。
shots.viewer_purpose: 每份证据有来源，一眼知道哪项产品对应哪份结果。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 卡片收束为排行榜候选
shots.observed: 作品缩略图退走，会员卡缩到右侧并进一步变为品牌圆标；一直退后的榜单前移成为主舞台。快速变化中能看到拖影，落位后边界清楚。
shots.viewer_purpose: 下一场承接同一组对象，不让观众重新辨认。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 候选图标进入榜单再回候选位
shots.observed: 品牌圆标在不同级别与候选位之间移动；锐评章与榜单角色分工清楚。此段只是预告比较，不能把临时排列当最终结论。
shots.viewer_purpose: 用同一个空间载体展示比较任务。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 第一名和最后一名的反差预告
shots.observed: 品牌信息换为问号，首尾档分别附第一名和最后一名，弧形虚线连接两端并指向疑问；不是再新增一屏标题。
shots.viewer_purpose: 把总体排名与局部能力不等价的冲突具象化。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 榜单缩为导航、单个会员接主位
shots.observed: 旧强调与弧线先退；左上章节标签到位；约17.9–18.3秒榜单缩入右上角，同时 Gemini 会员卡从右侧接入主位，略带转角后落稳。
shots.viewer_purpose: 缩小后的榜单继续有用途，后文随结论更新。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 产品身份让位给真实界面
shots.observed: 会员卡向左缩小，真实聊天截图占右侧主位；价格先附着界面，再加不太值的评价章。
shots.viewer_purpose: 先让真实证据可见，再让评价进入。
shots.evidence_level: local sequential visual samples and targeted 8fps sequences; full-video tool corroboration

shots.title: 额度截图局部强调
shots.observed: 用量限制截图放大到可读，圈出已使用100%，追加三家里最少标签；会员身份继续留在左侧。
shots.viewer_purpose: 突出原始证据中支持当前判断的字段。
